build_DatasetFromList: build a DatasetFromList to wrap a Python list as a PyTorch map-style dataset
build_MapDataset: build a MapDataset to apply a mapping function that transforms each dataset element
build_AspectRatioGroupedDataset: build an AspectRatioGroupedDataset to group samples by aspect ratio for batched training
build_detection_train_loader: build a detection training data loader with configurable dataset, sampler, and mapper
build_detection_test_loader: build a detection test data loader for inference with a custom sampler and mapper
